-- This is the main function that runs and scans all vehicles in front and behind the patrol vehicle
function SHX1_1:SHX32_1()
	-- Check that the system can actually run
	if ( PLY:VehicleStateValid() and self:SHX22_1() ) then
		-- Loop through front (1) and rear (-1)
		for SHX33_1 = 1, -1, -2 do
			-- Get the world position of the player's vehicle
			local SHX34_1 = GetEntityCoords( PLY.veh )

			-- Get a start position 5m in front/behind the player's vehicle
			local SHX35_1 = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords( PLY.veh, 0.0, ( 5.0 * SHX33_1 ), 0.0 )

			-- Get the end position 50m in front/behind the player's vehicle
			local SHX36_1 = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords( PLY.veh, -2.5, ( 50.0 * SHX33_1 ), 0.0 )

			-- Run the ray trace to get a vehicle
			local SHX37_1 = UTIL:GetVehicleInDirection( PLY.veh, SHX35_1, SHX36_1 )

			-- Get the plate reader text for front/rear
			local SHX10_1 = self:SHX24_1( SHX33_1 )

			-- Only proceed to read a plate if the hit entity is a valid vehicle and the current camera isn't locked
			if ( DoesEntityExist( SHX37_1 ) and IsEntityAVehicle( SHX37_1 ) and not self:SHX17_1( SHX10_1 ) ) then
				-- Get the heading of the player's vehicle and the hit vehicle
				local SHX38_1 = UTIL:Round( GetEntityHeading( PLY.veh ), 0 )
				local SHX39_1 = UTIL:Round( GetEntityHeading( SHX37_1 ), 0 )

				-- Get the relative direction between the player's vehicle and the hit vehicle
				local SHX40_1 = UTIL:GetEntityRelativeDirection( SHX38_1, SHX39_1 )

				-- Only run the rest of the plate check code if we can see the front or rear of the vehicle
				if ( SHX40_1 > 0 ) then
					-- Get the licence plate text from the vehicle
					local SHX2_1 = GetVehicleNumberPlateText( SHX37_1 )

					-- Get the licence plate index from the vehicle
					local SHX3_1 = GetVehicleNumberPlateTextIndex( SHX37_1 )

					-- Only update the stored plate if it's different, otherwise we'd keep sending a NUI message to update the displayed
					-- plate and image even though they're the same
					if ( self:SHX9_1( SHX10_1 ) ~= SHX2_1 ) then
						-- Set the plate for the current reader
						self:SHX11_1( SHX10_1, SHX2_1 )

						-- Set the plate index for the current reader
						self:SHX13_1( SHX10_1, SHX3_1 )

						-- Automatically lock the plate if the scanned plate matches the BOLO
						if ( SHX2_1 == self:SHX14_1() ) then
							self:SHX18_1( SHX10_1, false, true )

							SYNC:LockReaderCam( SHX10_1, SHX1_1:SHX27_1( SHX10_1 ) )
						end

						-- Send the plate information to the NUI side to update the UI
						SendNUIMessage( { _type = "changePlate", SHX10_1 = SHX10_1, SHX2_1 = SHX2_1, SHX3_1 = SHX3_1 } )

						-- If we use Sonoran CAD, reduce the plate events to just player's vehicle, otherwise life as normal
						if ( ( CONFIG.use_sonorancad and ( UTIL:IsPlayerInVeh( SHX37_1 ) or IsVehiclePreviouslyOwnedByPlayer( SHX37_1 ) ) and GetVehicleClass( SHX37_1 ) ~= 18 ) or not CONFIG.use_sonorancad ) then
							-- Trigger the event so developers can hook into the scanner every time a plate is scanned
							TriggerServerEvent( "wk:onPlateScanned", SHX10_1, SHX2_1, SHX3_1 )
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

		SHX1_1:SHX32_1()

end )

-- This function is pretty much straight from WraithRS, it does the job so I didn't see the point in not

function SHX1_1:SHX41_1()
	if ( ( ( PLY.veh == 0 or ( PLY.veh > 0 and not PLY.vehClassValid ) ) and self:SHX4_1() and not self:SHX7_1() ) or IsPauseMenuActive() and self:SHX4_1() ) then

		self:SHX8_1( false )
		SendNUIMessage( { _type = "setReaderDisplayState", SHX6_1 = true } )
	end
end

Citizen.CreateThread( function()

	while ( true ) do
		-- Run the check
		SHX1_1:SHX41_1()

		-- Wait half a second
		Citizen.Wait( 500 )
	end
end )

	return DoesEntityExist( self.veh ) and self.veh > 0 and self.vehClassValid
end

-- Used to check if the player is in a position where the radar should be allowed operation
function SHX1_1:SHX4_1()
	return self:SHX3_1() and self.inDriverSeat

-- Returns if the player is in the front passenger seat of an emergency vehicle

	return self:SHX4_1() or ( self:SHX5_1() and RADAR:IsPassengerControlAllowed() )
end

-- Returns the ped in the opposite seat to the player, e.g. if we're the passenger, then return the driver

	elseif ( self:SHX5_1() ) then

	end

	if ( SHX10_1 ~= nil and SHX10_1 ~= 0 and IsPedAPlayer( SHX10_1 ) ) then
		local SHX11_1 = GetPlayerServerId( NetworkGetPlayerIndexFromPed( SHX10_1 ) )

-- The main purpose of this thread is to update the information about the local player, including their
-- ped id, the vehicle id (if they're in one), whether they're in a driver seat, and if the vehicle's class
-- is valid or not
Citizen.CreateThread( function()
	while ( true ) do
		PLY.ped = PlayerPedId()
		PLY.veh = GetVehiclePedIsIn( PLY.ped, false )
		PLY.inDriverSeat = GetPedInVehicleSeat( PLY.veh, -1 ) == PLY.ped
		PLY.inPassengerSeat = GetPedInVehicleSeat( PLY.veh, 0 ) == PLY.ped
		PLY.vehClassValid = GetVehicleClass( PLY.veh ) == 18

		Citizen.Wait( 500 )
	end

Citizen.CreateThread( function()
	while ( true ) do
		-- The sync trigger should only start when the player is getting into a vehicle
		if ( IsPedGettingIntoAVehicle( PLY.ped ) and RADAR:IsPassengerViewAllowed() ) then
			-- Get the vehicle the player is entering
			local SHX12_1 = GetVehiclePedIsEntering( PLY.ped )

			-- Only proceed if the vehicle the player is entering is an emergency vehicle
			if ( GetVehicleClass( SHX12_1 ) == 18 ) then
				-- Wait two seconds, this gives enough time for the player to get sat in the seat
				Citizen.Wait( 2000 )

				-- Get the vehicle the player is now in
				local SHX2_1 = GetVehiclePedIsIn( PLY.ped, false )

				-- Trigger the main sync data function if the vehicle the player is now in is the same as the one they
				-- began entering
				if ( SHX2_1 == SHX12_1 ) then
					SYNC:SyncDataOnEnter()
				end
			end
		end

		Citizen.Wait( 500 )
	end
end )

-- sphere intersect calculation has a 'tProj' value that is a line from the centre of the sphere that goes onto
-- the line being traced. This value will either be positive or negative and can be used to work out the

	elseif ( SHX17_1 < -8.0 ) then

-- This function is used to check if a line going from point A to B intersects with a given sphere, it's used in
-- the radar system to check if the patrol vehicle can detect any vehicles. As the default ray trace system in GTA
-- cannot detect vehicles beyond 40~ units, my system acts as a replacement that allows the detection of vehicles
-- much further away (400+ units). Also, as my system uses sphere intersections, each sphere can have a different
-- radius, which means that larger vehicles can have larger spheres, and smaller vehicles can have smaller spheres.
function RADAR:SHX35_1( SHX36_1, SHX37_1, SHX38_1, SHX39_1 )
	-- Take the vector3's and turn them into vector2's, this way all of the calculations below are for an
	-- infinite cylinder rather than a sphere, which also means that vehicles can be detected even when on
	-- an incline!
	local SHX40_1 = vector2( rs.x, rs.y )
	local SHX41_1 = vector2( re.x, re.y )
	local SHX42_1 = vector2( c.x, c.y )

	-- First we get the normalised ray, this way we then know the direction the ray is going
	local SHX43_1 = norm( SHX41_1 - SHX40_1 )

	-- Then we calculate the ray from the start point to the centre position of the sphere
	local SHX44_1 = SHX42_1 - SHX40_1

	-- Now that we have the ray to the centre of the sphere, and the normalised ray direction, we
	-- can calculate the shortest point from the centre of the sphere onto the ray itself. This
	-- would then give us the opposite side of the right angled triangle. All of the resulting
	-- values are also in squared form, as performing square root functions is slower.
	local SHX45_1 = dot( SHX44_1, SHX43_1 )
	local SHX46_1 = dot( SHX44_1, SHX44_1 ) - ( SHX45_1 * SHX45_1 )

	-- Square the radius
	local SHX47_1 = SHX37_1 * SHX37_1

	-- Calculate the distance of the ray trace to make sure we only return valid results if the trace
	-- is actually within the distance
	local SHX48_1 = #( SHX41_1 - SHX40_1 )
	local SHX49_1 = #( SHX40_1 - SHX42_1 ) - ( SHX37_1 * 2 )

	-- Now all we have to do is compare the squared opposite length and the radius squared, this
	-- will then tell us if the ray intersects with the sphere.
	if ( SHX46_1 < SHX47_1 and not ( SHX49_1 > SHX48_1 ) ) then
		return true, self:SHX34_1( SHX45_1 )
	end

	return false, nil
end

function RADAR:SHX1_1( SHX2_1, SHX3_1, SHX4_1 )

		-- control system, as in theory one player could be in the operator menu, and the other player could lock a speed.
		local SHX5_1 = self:IsMenuOpen()

		-- reset the lock
		if ( not self:IsAntennaSpeedLocked( SHX2_1 ) ) then

			-- speed data provided in the override table.
			if ( SHX3_1 ~= nil ) then

			-- recipients display can't be trusted. When the player who locks the speed triggers the sync, their
			-- speed data is collected and sent to the other player so that their speed data is overriden to be the same.
			SHX3_1 = SHX3_1 or { nil, nil, nil, nil }

			-- Set up a temporary table with 3 nil values, this way if the system isn't able to get a speed or
			-- direction, the speed lock function won't work
			local SHX6_1 = { nil, nil, nil }

			-- As the lock system is based on which speed is displayed, we have to check if there is a speed in the
			-- fast box, if there is then we lock in the fast speed, otherwise we lock in the strongest speed
			if ( self:IsFastDisplayEnabled() and self:DoesAntennaHaveValidFastData( SHX2_1 ) ) then
